approach1.title: Research first, build fast
approach1.description: Every idea starts with genuine curiosity — we study the space, look for what's missing, then move immediately. No endless planning.

approach1.title: Solve small things brilliantly
approach1.description: AI won't fix everything. But it can make one hard thing effortless. We chase that — not the hype, not the headlines.

approach1.title: Innovation is always worth it
approach1.description: If it simplifies something complex, it's worth building. The world is full of broken processes waiting for a smarter solution.

approach1.title: Validate early, validate fast
approach1.description: A great product is one users confirm in the market — not one we fall in love with in a doc. Real signal beats internal conviction every time.

approach1.title: Own your stack, own your future
approach1.description: Most AI products collapse because they're built on top of expensive commercial models with no exit. We build lean, independent, and sustainable from day one.
